verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs describe it as using its own internal 'small and efficient AI models' for browser-agent tasks, and none of the documentation, CLI, or API references mention any mechanism for developers to configure or swap in their own LLM provider (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, custom model endpoints). This suggests the opposite of model-agnosticism — the models are an implementation detail of the service, not a pluggable choice.
